note: Curated by hand from the PDF, not parsed. The document is 23 irregular free-text sections with no stable structure, so a regex parser would be more fragile than a reviewed file. Each bullet is routed to exactly one destination: a placing that carries BOTH a source and a year becomes a `rankings` entry; an award, rating or accreditation becomes an `awards` entry; a list of graduate employers becomes `employability.employers`; everything else is kept verbatim under its own PDF heading in `recognition`. Nothing is duplicated and nothing is dropped.

Its bullets describe a student guardianship and homestay agency ('Guardianship Clients: 5,004', 'Homestay in UK', 'Minor students are required to have a homestay and guardian to study in school'). Seeding it against a real institution would publish plainly false information, so it is reported rather than imported.
